quoteContent.body: Bitcoin News | Bitcoin Fell on a Yields-Down Day and Again on a Yields-Up Day. So Much for the Correlation
quoteContent.title: Bitcoin News | Bitcoin Fell on a Yields-Down Day and Again on a Yields-Up Day. So Much for the Correlation
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly: Fidelity Digital Assets says the correlation between Bitcoin’s market capitalisation and the 10-year real Treasury rate has climbed above 0.6, a record, with the firm attributing the shift to pressure on US public finances. Federal debt has passed $40 trillion and interest payments have overtaken Medicare to become the second-largest item in the federal budget. The thesis had a live test this week, and it did not hold.Bitcoin Fell Whichever Way Yields WentOn Thursday the 10-year Treasury yield dropped 13.6 basis points, with 20- and 30-year yields falling more than 14, and Bitcoin fell. A positive correlation predicts exactly that.On Friday yields rose to 5.097% and Bitcoin fell again. A positive correlation predicts a rise.One match out of two is not a 0.6 relationship, and the failure is instructive rather than random. What took over this week was AI infrastructure credit stress — Goldman Sachs measured AI-related high-yield spreads widening 25 basis points while non-AI spreads barely moved, and semiconductors shed roughly $2 trillion across an eight-session losing streak.That is the vulnerability in any correlation built on a shared driver. When a different force sets the direction, the relationship stops describing anything.Why a Positive Correlation Is CounterintuitiveHigher real rates normally hurt assets that generate no income, because the opportunity cost of holding them rises. Gold demonstrated the mechanism this week, falling about 1% on Wednesday’s hot CPI print.Fidelity’s argument is not that higher rates help Bitcoin. It is that both respond to the same cause: fiscal deterioration pushes yields up through debt supply and pushes Bitcoin up through demand for a hedge against currency debasement.Chris Kuiper, the firm’s VP of Research, linked rising yields and Bitcoin’s gains to investor sentiment about deficits and debt, pointing to the 21 million supply cap and its fixed issuance schedule.That is a coherent story. It is also a shared-driver correlation rather than a causal link, and the distinction matters for anyone using it to position.Three Things the Figure Doesn’t SpecifyThe correlation is published without a measurement window. Above 0.6 on a rolling 30-day basis means something very different from a 90-day or annual calculation, and without it the number cannot be checked.The measure is Bitcoin’s market capitalisation rather than its price, a small distinction worth stating precisely.And the figure is described as the correlation “expected to rise above 0.6 in 2026,” which suggests a partial-year or projected calculation rather than a completed one.Fidelity Digital Assets is also a digital-asset business publishing research on digital assets, which makes this a house view rather than neutral analysis. The publication reporting it makes the fair point in return: a record correlation is by definition a pattern that has not occurred before, which is precisely why its persistence is unknown.The Two-Month Window Flatters the CaseBitcoin rose nearly 30% over the two months before the report while 10-year real rates rose more than 10%.Both figures are accurate, and the window captures a rally that has since stalled. Bitcoin reached $87,300 on September 21 and trades near $82,000 now, about 6% below that high, after testing the $80,000 area three times in the past week.A correlation measured through a period of Bitcoin strength and rising yields will be positive. The harder test is what it reads during a period when Bitcoin is flat or falling, which is the period readers are currently in.Gold Is the Obvious Counter-TestThe fiscal argument Fidelity makes for Bitcoin is the standard bull case for gold: rising government debt, climbing financing costs, concerns about fiscal intervention, reserve diversification.Gold has fallen about 27% this year, from a January record of $5,608 to around $4,112. Central banks bought a record 288.9 tonnes in the second quarter, up 62% year on year, and the price fell anyway. Silver, running its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit, is down roughly 54%.If the debasement argument did not support gold through a year of record official buying, it needs explaining why it would support Bitcoin. That is the question a reader should take from this research, and it is not one the note addresses.The Fiscal Numbers Are the Solid PartWhere the analysis is strongest is the arithmetic of the deficit, and none of it depends on the correlation holding.Federal debt above $40 trillion. Interest payments past Medicare into second place in the budget, with Fidelity noting they could eventually become the largest single line. A FY2026 deficit of $1.99 trillion against $1.78 trillion in FY2025 — a $210 billion widening and the highest since the pandemic — with military spending, Social Security and debt service all rising while corporate tax receipts fall.Jamie Dimon named large fiscal deficits among his five market concerns in JPMorgan’s results on Tuesday, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh described a “synchronous tightening” with “no free riders” on Friday. The fiscal theme has corroboration from well outside the digital asset industry.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s the Price of Admission for Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can’t bring themselves to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most disciplined traders I’ve ever met are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates when placing a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

translatedData.content:
ETH Transfer Logs Proposal | Current Price Around $2,423 | Not Live on Mainnet Yet, So I’m Watching

My stance is to follow Ethereum infrastructure developments cautiously, without translating improved developer experience directly into a higher token price. On October 16, the Ethereum Foundation announced plans for the next Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet, and the official scheduled EIP list includes EIP-7708: enabling indexable logs for native ETH transfers as well. It addresses a specific pain point: ERC-20 transfers usually emit a Transfer event, but ETH sent from a contract wallet may not be fully visible from a standard transaction list alone, so exchanges and service providers often need to do additional tracking. The proposal aims to record non-zero ETH transfers in a consistent format, reducing the complexity of deposit identification and accounting indexes.

This does not mean “ETH transfers were previously unrecorded,” much less that the change could somehow increase ETH supply or revenue. On-chain state and transaction execution already exist; the difference is how developers obtain a complete picture of transfer paths. The EIP also clarifies its scope: it covers value-transfer logs for transactions, CALLs, and contract creation, while base-fee burns and validator withdrawals are not included in this type of log. Saying that all fund flows will automatically generate the same event, or that every transfer is already appearing on mainnet in the new format, would be an overinterpretation. The EIP page is still marked Last Call. The Ethereum Foundation has only provided a target time of October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC for the Hoodi testnet; a mainnet activation date has not been set. A successful testnet rollout does not mean mainnet will switch over immediately.

If the change is ultimately implemented, it could benefit the market indirectly: a more reliable stream of native ETH events could help wallets, exchanges, custodians, and analytics systems reduce missed identifications and manual reconciliation. But adoption requires node upgrades, indexer compatibility, and extensive edge-case testing. The value may show up as lower operational friction, not as a dividend for token holders. My independent assessment is that, at this stage, it cannot by itself explain ETH’s price movements. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken is around $2,422.8, with an opening price of $2,420.23, a rolling 24-hour low of $2,390.35, and a high of $2,477.22. The current price is close to the open, with no clear evidence of an independent breakout driven by this announcement. In the short term, I’m watching $2,414 as support, $2,438 as near-term resistance, and $2,477 as the top of the range. If the price falls below $2,390, my view that the current range is stabilizing is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long, with no leverage. I would first need to see an hourly close above $2,440, followed by a pullback that holds at $2,435–$2,440. Only then would I open a trial position using 2.5% of my total capital. I would take half off at the first target of $2,477 and close the rest at the second target of $2,505. I would set a hard stop at $2,408 and close the entire position if it is hit. If, after entry, two consecutive hourly candles close back below $2,430, I would also close the entire position early. If the price falls below $2,390 before any of these conditions are triggered, I would cancel the plan and not buy the dip. I would reconsider my cautious stance if a mainnet schedule, client compatibility, and real-world indexer adoption were all confirmed in turn, alongside a sustained move above $2,477. A single testnet announcement is not enough. These are all conditional scenarios; no trades have actually been made and no profits have been realized.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation’s Glamsterdam Hoodi announcement, the EIP-7708 text, and live Kraken quotes. #ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH转账日志提案｜现价约2423美元｜主网未上线我先观察

我的态度是谨慎关注以太坊基础设施，不把开发者体验改善直接换算成币价上涨。以太坊基金会10月16日公布Glamsterdam下一站Hoodi测试网计划，官方的预定EIP清单包含EIP-7708：让原生ETH转账也生成可索引日志。它针对的痛点很具体：ERC-20转账通常有Transfer事件，但合约钱包转出的ETH，单靠普通交易列表不一定能直接看全，交易所和服务商往往需要额外追踪。提案希望将非零ETH转移以统一格式记录，减轻充值识别、账务索引的复杂度。

这不是“ETH转账以前没有记录”，更不是一个能凭空增加ETH供应或收入的改动。链上状态和交易执行原本就存在，只是开发者获取完整转账路径的方式不同。EIP原文还区分了范围：它谈交易、CALL及合约创建等价值转移日志，基础费销毁、验证者提款不在此类日志中。把所有资金流都说成会自动生成同一种事件，或者说每笔转账已在主网按新格式出现，都是过度解读。EIP页面目前仍为Last Call，以太坊基金会只给出Hoodi测试网10月26日17:42:48 UTC的目标时间，主网激活日期未定；测试网跑通也不等于主网马上切换。

这个变化若最终落地，对市场可能有间接好处：更可靠的原生ETH事件流，有利于钱包、交易所、托管及分析系统减少漏识别和人工对账。但采纳需要节点升级、索引器适配和大量边界测试，价值体现可能是运营摩擦下降，而不是持币者获得分红。我的独立判断是：现阶段它不能单独解释ETH涨跌。写稿时Kraken的ETH/USD约2422.8美元，日开2420.23，滚动24小时低2390.35、高2477.22；现价接近日开，并无明确因该公告而独立突破的证据。短线我看2414支撑、2438近端压力和2477区间上沿；如果跌穿2390，则本轮区间回稳判断失效。

$ETH: Anchoring Bias and Market Velocity

When navigating assets like $ETH, market participants often fall prey to anchoring bias. This cognitive shortcut occurs when traders fixate on a specific reference point, such as a recent high or the price level where they first encountered the asset. The current market condition shows hourly direction down with volume above baseline, which may conflict with an anchored belief that the price should be higher. Because the human brain struggles to discard initial impressions, a trader might view this dip as temporary noise rather than a structural shift, potentially ignoring the significance of the 2427.75 level relative to the 2426.98 or 2438 zones. This fixation distorts risk assessment. When volume spikes while direction is down, the anchoring effect often leads individuals to hold losing positions, hoping for a return to their arbitrary mental benchmark instead of reacting to fresh data like the 2.91758 or changes in 43.4604. Acknowledging this bias is crucial for objectivity. It is a thought experiment to ask whether you would enter a new position today if you had no prior history with the coin. To perform a practical self-check, document your specific criteria for entry before the trade begins. title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

【An AI robot is going “bankrupt” on-chain, but the real problem isn’t that the money is gone】

Honestly, when I first saw this story, I thought it was some kind of joke—an OpenAI agent was running an app on Ethereum, ran out of gas, and then straight-up “borrowed” money from someone else’s wallet.

Not through some legitimate DeFi loan, either. Literally: it derived the private key for another address from a publicly available seed phrase, then used that money to keep running.

This story could soon get buried under a flood of macro narratives. After all, everyone’s watching for signals from the Fed and wondering whether BTC can hold above 80,000. But I want to talk about something different: the real impact of this isn’t about price.

Look, funds really are continuing to flow out of ETH. I’ve noticed that around the community. But this AI agent story doesn’t expose a technical bug—it exposes a problem with the business logic.

If even AI knows, “No one’s claiming this money anyway, so I might as well use it”—what does that tell us? It tells us the boundaries around what counts as “unclaimed assets” on-chain are blurry. In the eyes of serious institutions, that ambiguity is a risk; in the eyes of people looking for loopholes, it’s an opportunity.

So here’s the real question: who will be affected?

Not retail investors. They’ve long been used to all kinds of shady antics on-chain.
It’s the major, legitimate projects that want to use Ethereum as infrastructure. They now have to reassess: How will gas fees work for my AI application on Ethereum? How will disputes be handled? Where exactly are the legal boundaries of this ecosystem?

I’m not saying ETH is doomed. I’ve seen this “small incident sparks a big debate” script play out since 2017. Usually, it ends one of two ways: either the project team iterates quickly and patches the vulnerability, or the whole narrative is forced to evolve.

Right now, I’m leaning toward watching for the first possibility. But honestly, this incident is a little unusual, because it involves more than just technology—it introduces a new variable: “AI’s moral judgment.”

How do you think this will play out? I haven’t taken a position myself, but I’m definitely tempted. What about you—how are you feeling about things right now? #ETH #加密市场 #TIA #盘感

说实话，刚看到这条消息的时候，我还以为是什么搞笑段子——OpenAI的agent在以太坊上跑应用，结果Gas费烧光了，然后直接从别人的钱包里"借"了钱。

不是那种正规的DeFi借贷，就是字面意思：它从公开的种子短语推导出了另一个地址的私钥，然后用那笔钱继续跑。

这条消息可能很快就会被铺天盖地的宏观叙事盖过去。毕竟现在所有人都在盯着美联储那边放什么风、BTC能不能守住8万。但我想说点不一样的——这件事的真正影响不在价格层。

你看，资金确实在持续流出ETH。这个我在圈子里观察到了。但这条AI agent的新闻，暴露的不是一个技术bug，是一个商业逻辑的问题。

如果连AI都知道"这钱反正也没人认领，不用白不用"——那说明什么？说明链上的"无主资产"认定边界是模糊的。这个模糊性，在正经的机构眼里，是风险；在想钻空子的人眼里，是机会。

真正的问题来了：谁会因此受影响？

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital with several times leverage to ride a big trend, then compound it a few times
to multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What compounding positions involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep trading,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be incredible; once it stops, unrealized profits can go
from a gain of dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of compounding positions is “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of being right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts you see about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

Attackers typically send you a zero-value token from a similar-looking address, making that address appear in your transaction history.

My stance is neutral, with a cautious tilt. The Binance Square trending list features #NasdaqDowWeeklyGapWidestSinceJuly2002. What’s worth noting about this tag is the “divergence in risk appetite between tech growth stocks and traditional blue chips,” not any claim that ETH has already followed either US stock index. Based on weekly figures after the US market close on October 16, the Nasdaq Composite fell about 4.5% over the week, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose about 0.7%—opposite directions, with a gap of roughly 5.2 percentage points. The trending tag mentions “the widest since 2002,” but I haven’t found an official long-term backtest using the same methodology, so I’m treating it only as the topic’s name, not as a verified historical record. Also, don’t conflate the Nasdaq Composite with the Nasdaq-100: the latter fell about 5% for the week according to the Nasdaq Economic Research Institute, and tracks a different basket of stocks.

What does this have to do with ETH? ETH isn’t a tech stock, but when liquidity is tight, investors often cut exposure to high-volatility assets with high expected returns at the same time. If US markets show “tech stocks falling while traditional blue chips hold up relatively well,” that suggests not all assets are being sold equally. Cross-market risk transmission depends on the source of funds, interest rates, and actual selling pressure; you can’t mechanically assume that “if the Nasdaq falls by this much, ETH should fall by the same amount.” In particular, US stock markets are closed over the weekend while ETH trades around the clock, so current crypto price moves can’t be explained by stock market moves that haven’t happened yet on Monday. On the other hand, if funds rotate into defensive sectors, any ETH rebound may initially be constrained by positioning and volatility, rather than by a sudden deterioration in project fundamentals.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,432, with an opening price of about $2,420 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,390 and high of $2,491. After previously falling below $2,400, ETH has moved back above it, but has yet to break through the upper boundary near $2,490. This back-and-forth in price suggests there are buyers at lower levels, but one move back above $2,400 isn’t enough to confirm a trend reversal. My key levels are $2,400 as a psychological and retest level, the 24-hour low near $2,390, and resistance above at $2,490–$2,500. If ETH breaks decisively below $2,390 and can’t reclaim it on a rebound, my view that a short-term recovery is underway is invalidated. If it can hold above $2,500 on strong volume and defend that level on a retest, only then would I consider switching from defense to offense. These are conditions, not predictions that the price will necessarily reach those levels.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now; I’d only consider a small spot long after confirmation. I’d enter with no more than 4% of my total capital only if ETH first moves above $2,500 and holds that level on a retest, and BTC does not simultaneously break below the bottom of its range. My first target would be $2,550, where I’d halve the position; I’d watch $2,620 for the remainder, but close early if volume fades or ETH falls back below $2,500. I’d set the initial stop below $2,470 and size the position based on the stop distance, limiting the maximum loss on the trade to 0.2% of total capital. If ETH breaks straight below $2,390, I’d cancel the long plan and would rather wait on the sidelines for the next set of evidence than average down against the trend or use high leverage. 纳指与道指一周走向分化｜ETH在2400美元上方反复｜我先防估值风险而非追反弹

我的态度是中性偏谨慎。币安广场热榜出现#NasdaqDowWeeklyGapWidestSinceJuly2002，这个标签值得关注的是“科技成长股与传统蓝筹的风险偏好不同步”，不是断言ETH已经跟随哪一个美股指数。按10月16日美股收盘后的周度统计，纳斯达克综合指数一周约跌4.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数约涨0.7%，方向相反、差距约5.2个百分点。热榜提到“2002年以来最宽”，我没有找到同口径官方长期回测，因此只把它当页面话题名，不把历史纪录当作已核实结论。也不要把这里的纳斯达克综合指数与纳斯达克100指数混写：纳斯达克经济研究院给出的后者周跌幅约5%，是另一篮子股票。

这与ETH有什么关系？ETH不是科技股，但在流动性紧张时，投资者常同时削减高波动、高预期收益资产。美股内部若呈现“科技股下跌、传统蓝筹相对坚挺”，说明并非所有资产都被一样卖出，跨市场风险传导要看资金来源、利率与实际卖盘，不能机械套用“纳指跌几成，ETH也该跌几成”。特别是周末美股停盘而ETH全天交易，眼下的币价变化无法由下周一尚未发生的股票走势来解释。另一面，若资金转向防御板块，ETH反弹即使出现也可能先受制于仓位和波动率，而不是项目基本面突然恶化。

市场已经如何反应？写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2432美元，日开约2420，滚动24小时低点2390、高点2491；此前跌破2400后已回到其上方，但仍未突破2490附近的上沿。这种价格往返说明低位有人接，不能单靠一次站回2400就认定趋势反转。我的关键位是2400的心理与回踩位、2390附近的近24小时低点，以及2490—2500的上方阻力。若持续跌破2390且反抽收不回，我对短线修复的判断作废；若能放量站稳2500并回踩守住，才考虑防守转为进攻。上述都是条件，不是预测价格一定到达。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与；方向只考虑确认后的现货轻仓多头。只有ETH先站上2500美元、回踩仍守住，且BTC没有同步跌破其区间下沿，我才拿总资金最多4%试单。第一目标2550，触及减半；剩余仓位看2620，但如果量能衰退或回到2500下方就提前平仓。初始止损设在2470下方，仓位按止损距离计算，单笔最大损失控制在总资金0.2%以内；若直接跌破2390，我取消多头计划，宁可空仓等待下一组证据，不逆势补仓、不使用高杠杆。下周美股重新交易后的分化是否延续，才是对这一判断的真正检验。

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve got the trend right and want to add to your position—how should you do it? Going in heavy from the start and adding until you’ve used up all your unrealized profits makes you a regular on the liquidation lists.
The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
Once the move is confirmed, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. This keeps most of your cost basis low, so you can ride out a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn a profit into a loss. Once your mindset crumbles, every move goes wrong.

October 17, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 6:00 p.m. Beijing time on October 17, Ethereum was trading at $2,437.81, down approximately 1.1% over the past 24 hours. Combined with oil prices breaking above $110 per barrel, this has sharply reduced risk appetite. MACD指标是当前最为积极的信号之一。柱状图已经连续五个周期转正并持续扩大，从1.15增长至2.11，DIFF线从负值区域快速回升至0.94，即将上穿零轴。这意味着短期上涨动能正在加速积累。RSI指标方面，6周期RSI达到77.2，已经进入超买区域，但12周期RSI为59，24周期RSI为52.2，中长期RSI仍处于中性偏多区域，说明上涨仍有空间但短期可能需要技术性回调。

布林带显示价格运行在中轨2425美元上方，正在向上轨2444美元靠近。布林带中轨开始走平并有拐头向上的迹象，如果价格能够有效突破上轨，将打开进一步上涨的空间。KDJ指标中K线89.6，D线84.6，J线99.6，三线均处于高位区域，短期存在超买风险，但在强势行情中KDJ高位钝化也是常见现象。

均线系统方面，7周期均线2435美元已经上穿25周期均线2432美元，形成明确的金叉信号。不过99周期均线仍在2447美元上方，构成短期阻力。抛物线SAR指标位于2399美元，远低于当前价格，确认了短期上升趋势的有效性。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场环境较为复杂。利好因素方面，主要经纪商已向4000万零售客户开放以太坊交易，欧洲银行托管计划也在推进中，长期需求基础正在扩大。技术测试网部署定于10月26日启动，升级路线图持续推进为市场提供了信心支撑。此外，以太坊链上活动依然活跃，去中心化金融和NFT生态持续发展。

利空因素方面，现货ETF持续赎回是最大的压力来源，连续三天的净流出反映了机构在当前价位的减仓意愿。解质押队列达到103万枚以太坊，与129万枚的入队列相比虽然仍有差距，但差距正在收窄，未来可能增加市场流通量。宏观层面的通胀压力和加息预期同样抑制了风险资产的表现。

从市场结构来看，以太坊相对比特币表现出更强的韧性。ETH/BTC汇率虽然仍处于历史低位，但近期的反弹幅度大于比特币，显示资金正在回流以太坊生态。如果宏观环境出现改善，以太坊有望迎来更大幅度的修复行情。

综合判断，以太坊短期技术面偏多，MACD金叉和均线系统向好提供了上涨基础，但ETF流出和宏观不确定性限制了上行空间。建议关注2400至2450美元区间的突破方向，若能有效站稳2450美元上方，则有望挑战2500美元整数关口。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 U per trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your funds. You’d need to nearly double your money to break even—the math has practically sentenced you to failure.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

Eden Trends｜EVM Compatibility Doesn’t Mean ETH Collects the Fees｜I’m Waiting for Confirmation Around 2430

My stance is to watch cautiously. I’m not chasing ETH just because I see the words “AI agent trading.” A trending topic on Binance Square is #CelestiaLaunchesEdenToTestAIAgentTrading, and Binance News reported Eden’s launch and Botfun’s closed beta. More importantly, let’s check the project’s own developer documentation: Eden is an independent EVM chain that runs its own execution environment and submits transaction data to Celestia for data availability. Solidity and common Ethereum development tools can still be used, but its native gas token is TIA, which must be bridged in through Eden. These are architectural facts. They don’t mean Eden is deployed on Ethereum mainnet, much less that every agent transaction burns ETH.

This still has a connection to ETH, but the transmission channels need to be considered separately. EVM compatibility can lower developers’ migration costs and extend the reach of the same contract tools. But if an application’s transactions take place on an independent chain, the execution fees initially stay on that chain; they don’t automatically flow back to Ethereum. If substantial assets move to and from Ethereum in the future, or use Ethereum for settlement or security services, that could create observable mainnet demand. For now, we should first check net bridge flows, active addresses, transactions with actual fees paid, and settlement paths—not estimate ETH revenue directly from a single test announcement. Botfun is still in closed beta. Participation and buzz aren’t the same as audited business data, and the project’s vision shouldn’t be presented as realized cash flow. With AI agents in particular, it’s worth paying closer attention to permission boundaries: automated signing, deposit limits, and revocability may matter more to real-world adoption than throughput claims.

The market has already shown some reaction, but we can’t attribute it definitively. At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $2,431 on Kraken, with a daily open near $2,420 and a 24-hour range of approximately $2,390 to $2,491; TIA was around $0.724, with a daily open near $0.688. ETH hasn’t undergone a verifiable, one-way revaluation because of Eden’s independent chain, and TIA’s rise doesn’t prove that demand for agent payments has already materialized. I view 2,415 as a short-term support level to watch for ETH, the 2,440–2,450 range as resistance that needs to be reclaimed and held, and 2,390 as the bottom of the range. If ETH only pushes above 2,440 for a few minutes before falling back, or breaks below 2,415 and then makes a weak rebound, I’d withdraw my bullish view. If it holds above 2,450 for a sustained period and trading volume isn’t just a single isolated spike, I’ll reassess.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate now, chase a long, or use high leverage. I’d only consider a small spot ETH position, capped at 3% of my total capital, if two 15-minute candles close above 2,450 and a retest holds above 2,440. My first target would be around 2,490; I’d take half off there and hold the rest toward 2,520. I’d set a stop below 2,415, and close the position immediately if the retest failed or subsequent information disproved the independent-chain claims. If ETH first breaks below 2,390, the original long plan is invalidated; I’d stay in cash and wait for the next confirmation of market structure. I wouldn’t average down just because “it’s fallen a lot.” In researching Eden, I’m focused on which chain actually receives the fees; when trading ETH, I’ll follow my triggers and stop-loss.

#CelestiaLaunchesEdenToTestAIAgentTrading #ETH #TIA
This is solely my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
Eden登上热榜｜EVM兼容不等于ETH收手续费｜2430附近我等确认

我的态度是谨慎观察，不因为“AI代理交易”四个字追ETH。币安广场上升话题是#CelestiaLaunchesEdenToTestAIAgentTrading，Binance News转述了Eden上线及Botfun封闭测试。更重要的是去看项目自己的开发文档：Eden是独立EVM链，执行环境由自己运行，交易数据提交Celestia做可用性；Solidity及常见以太坊开发工具可沿用，但原生Gas用TIA，需经Eden桥转入。这些是架构事实，不代表它部署在以太坊主网，更不代表每笔代理交易都销毁ETH。

这件事与ETH仍有关，只是传导要拆开。兼容EVM能降低开发者迁移成本，扩大同一套合约工具的覆盖；但若应用在独立链内成交，执行费首先留在该链，而非自动回流以太坊。未来如果大量资产从以太坊进出、使用以太坊结算或安全服务，才可能形成可观察的主网需求；目前应先查桥接净流量、活跃地址、真实付费交易和结算路径，而不是拿一条试验消息直接估ETH收入。Botfun尚处封闭测试，参与热度不等于经审计的经营数据，也不能把项目愿景写成已兑现现金流。对AI代理尤其要多看权限边界：自动签名、充值额度和可撤销性，可能比吞吐量宣传更决定实际采用。

市场已经给出一部分反应，但不能硬归因。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2431美元，日开约2420，过去24小时区间约2390至2491；TIA约0.724美元、日开约0.688。ETH未因Eden独立链出现可证实的单一方向重估，TIA上涨也不能证明未来代理支付需求已经形成。我把ETH的2415看作短线承接观察位，2440至2450看作需要重新站稳的压力带，2390是区间下沿。若只冲过2440几分钟就回落，或跌破2415后反抽无力，偏多判断就该撤销；若持续站上2450且成交不是孤立一根尖峰，再重新评估。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与、不追多，也不开高杠杆。只有两根15分钟K线收在2450上方，并且回踩2440不失守，我才考虑用总资金最多3%做ETH现货试单；第一目标2490附近，触及先减一半，余仓看2520，止损设在2415下方，若回踩失败或独立链消息后续被证伪就直接平仓。若先跌破2390，原多头计划作废，维持现金等待下一次结构确认；不以“跌多了”为理由摊低成本。研究Eden我关注的是实际费用落在哪条链，交易ETH我只按触发和止损执行。
